group.label: Documentation
group.comment: Ground the assistant on Magento admin how-to documentation so it gives correct procedures. Fetched into your database; nothing is bundled.

field.label: Enable documentation grounding
field.comment: When enabled, a cron indexes the docs into the mago_doc table (~5 MB) on the schedule below. For an immediate first index, run bin/magento mago:docs:index --force.

field.label: Source repository
field.comment: GitHub owner/repo. Default is the MIT-licensed Mage-OS mirror of Adobe's Commerce Admin docs. Content is Magento/Adobe Commerce documentation, not Mage-OS-specific.

field.label: Source branch / commit
field.comment: Which branch or commit of the source repository above to index (e.g. main). Pin to a commit for reproducible results.

field.label: Results per search
field.comment: Max number of documentation pages pulled in as context per search (default 5). Higher = broader but noisier and more costly.

field.label: Sync schedule
field.comment: Cron expression for the re-index job (default 0 4 1 * *, monthly). A no-op sync costs one API call, so raise the frequency if you feed custom docs that change more often.
